system_settings.description: User management, role permissions, activity audit logs, account profile, and application overview.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.purpose: Monitor real-time gate operational metrics and daily visitor activity at a glance.

features.metrics: Real-time metric cards (active visits, monthly total, available cards, blacklisted visitors)
features.weekly_trend: Weekly visit trend chart and availability summary for visitor & vehicle cards
features.active_visitors: Live table of visitors currently inside the shipyard (In Yard)

add_visit.title: Add Visit
add_visit.purpose: Register new visitor arrivals and process gate check-ins.

features.registration_modes: Fast lookup of registered visitors by Name (autocomplete) or ID Number
features.id_detection: Automatic detection of ID numbers (KTP, Driving License, Passport) along with past visit count
features.blacklist_alert: Automatic warning and check-in block when a visitor is on the Blacklist
features.host_and_cards: Assign destination location/vessel & Host staff, followed by mandatory physical visitor card and optional vehicle card selection
features.print_pass: Direct ½ A4 Visitor Pass ticket printing upon selecting a visitor card and successful check-in

add_visit.title: Register a new visit

steps.1: Type the visitor Name to pick from autocomplete suggestions, or select ID Type (KTP, Driving License, Passport), enter the ID Number, and click Check ID number.
steps.2: Check the status panel on the right; the system automatically blocks visitors on the Blacklist, or prompts registration in Visitor Directory first if unregistered.
steps.3: In the Destination & Host Staff section, select the Destination Location / Vessel, enter the Purpose of visit, and select the Host Staff.
steps.4: In the Access Cards & Vehicle section, select an Available physical Visitor Card (mandatory), plus license plate and vehicle card if bringing a vehicle.
steps.5: Click Save & Print Ticket on the bottom bar to save the visit and print the ½ A4 Visitor Pass ticket.

add_visit.tip: Ensure at least one Available physical visitor card is selected before clicking Save & Print Ticket.

visit_history.title: Visit History
visit_history.purpose: Search, track, reprint passes, edit active visits, and process visitor check-outs.

features.quick_search: Fast search by vehicle license plate, ticket number, visitor name, or company
features.status_filter: Filter by active visits (In Yard) or completed visits (Checked Out)
features.checkout: Individual visitor check-out and bulk check-out for groups
features.reprint_and_edit: Reprint visitor entry pass (Reprint Pass) and edit active visit details
features.auto_card_release: Automatic release of visitor and vehicle cards back to Available status on check-out

checkout.title: Check out a visit

steps.1: Make sure the status filter is set to active visits (In Yard).
steps.2: Type the vehicle license plate, ticket number, visitor name, or company in the quick search box.
steps.3: Click the Check-out button on an individual row, or select multiple rows for group Bulk Check-Out.
steps.4: Confirm the check-out so the visitor and vehicle cards are automatically released to Available.

checkout.tip: Use vehicle license plate search to speed up check-out at the exit gate.

reprint_edit.title: Reprint or edit an active pass

steps.1: Find the active visit (In Yard) in the visit history table.
steps.2: Click the Reprint Pass action to open the Visitor Pass reprint screen.
steps.3: Click the Edit action to update active visit details such as destination or access cards, then save.

reprint_edit.tip: Completed visits (Checked Out) cannot be modified.

crew_arrivals.title: Crew Arrivals
crew_arrivals.purpose: Manage vessel arrivals (Repair Vessels and permanent staying Tugboats/Barges) alongside seafarer crew manifest placements and movements.

features.unified_search: Unified search to quickly locate berthed vessels and individual seafarers
features.register_arrival: Register new vessel arrivals with schedule, port, local/foreign agents, and initial crew manifest
features.manifest_tabs: Crew manifest monitoring tabs (Active, Expected, Completed) alongside the crew movement logs history tab
features.crew_actions: Crew Check-In (strict 1-to-1 placement rule), Check-Out, Detach Crew, and activity movement logging
features.export_and_depart: Departure/sign-out workflow for Repair Vessels, while Tugboats & Barges remain permanently staying in yard without check-out

register_arrival.title: Register a vessel arrival

steps.1: Ensure the vessel record exists in Locations & Vessels and seafarer profiles exist in Visitor Directory with Visitor Type set to Crew.
steps.2: Click Record New Arrival on the Crew Arrivals page, then select the berthed vessel, arrival schedule, and port of origin.
steps.3: Fill in local and foreign shipping agent details along with contact persons.
steps.4: Select and link seafarers into the vessel crew manifest and save (seafarers must be linked to a vessel arrival before Check-In and Check-Out are enabled).

register_arrival.tip: Seafarers who are not yet linked to a vessel arrival manifest cannot perform Check-In or Check-Out.

manage_manifest.title: Manage crew manifest & actions

steps.1: Fastest method: type the seafarer name or vessel name in the Unified Search bar at the top of the page to open crew actions or manifest details immediately.
steps.2: Or click the Detail button on a vessel table row to view the manifest tabs (Active On-Board, Expected, Completed History).
steps.3: Click Crew Check-In or Check-Out on the seafarer row to record gate movements (strict 1-to-1 placement rule).
steps.4: Use Detach Crew or Transfer Vessel if a seafarer changes assignment to another vessel.

manage_manifest.tip: Crew Check-In and Check-Out buttons are accessible from both the Unified Search bar and the Vessel Manifest Detail modal.

export_depart.title: Export logs & mark vessel departed

steps.1: Open the vessel arrival detail modal and switch to the crew movement activity log tab.
steps.2: Click Export Excel to download the crew movement log summary as an .xlsx file.
steps.3: When a Repair Vessel completes work and leaves the shipyard, click the Check-Out / Departed button on the vessel row or inside the vessel detail modal.

export_depart.tip: Tugboats and Barges stay permanently in the yard and do not require vessel departure check-out.

locations_vessels.title: Locations & Vessels
locations_vessels.purpose: Manage shipyard areas (jetties, workshops, offices) and master records for berthed vessels.

features.yard_zones: Manage yard land zones, workshops, wharves, and vessel classifications (Tugboat, Barge, or Repair Vessel)
features.vessel_details: Store vessel metadata including IMO number, Call Sign, flag, captain, and vessel PIC
features.import_export: Full Excel/CSV template Import and Export support for Locations & Vessels

manage_records.title: Add, edit & delete location or vessel records

steps.1: Click the add button to open the registration form for a new yard location or vessel.
steps.2: Select the entity classification (land zone, wharf, Tugboat, Barge, or Repair Vessel) and fill in metadata such as IMO, Call Sign, flag, and PIC.
steps.3: Save the new record, or use the Edit action on a table row to update existing location and vessel details.
steps.4: Use the Delete action on unused records that have no linked active transactions.

manage_records.tip: Make sure the vessel classification (Repair Vessel vs Tugboat/Barge) is selected accurately because it governs departure behavior.

import_export.title: Import & Export records via Excel/CSV

steps.1: Click the Import button and download the official Excel/CSV template provided in the dialog.
steps.2: Fill in the location or vessel rows in the template following the required column format.
steps.3: Upload the completed file, review the validation preview table, and confirm the Import.
steps.4: Click the Export button at any time to download all Locations & Vessels into an Excel/CSV file.

import_export.tip: Always start from the latest template so column headers match the system validation rules.

staffs.title: Staffs
staffs.purpose: Manage the directory of internal employees who serve as visitor hosts.

features.host_directory: Quick lookup of staff names, employee IDs, titles, and contact details
features.department_status: Manage department assignments and active/inactive staff status
features.import_export: Bulk Import and Export of staff records via Excel/CSV files

manage_records.title: Add, edit & delete host staff records

steps.1: Click the add staff button to open the employee host registration form.
steps.2: Enter the full name, employee ID number, department, job title, and contact number.
steps.3: Toggle active/inactive status or use the Edit action in the table to update employee details.
steps.4: Use the Delete action to remove duplicate staff entries that have no visit history.

manage_records.tip: Set transferred or retired employees to inactive so they no longer appear in the Host selector during check-in.

import_export.title: Import & Export staff directory

steps.1: Open the Import dialog on the Staffs page and download the Excel/CSV template.
steps.2: Populate employee names, IDs, departments, and job titles in the template file.
steps.3: Upload the file in the Import dialog, review row validation results, and save in bulk.
steps.4: Use the Export button to download the directory of active and inactive staff.

import_export.tip: Ensure employee ID numbers are unique to prevent duplicates during bulk Import.

cards.title: Cards
cards.purpose: Manage the inventory of physical visitor access cards (RFID/Barcode) issued at the gate.

features.physical_cards: Register physical visitor card numbers and badge codes
features.status_tracking: Track real-time card status: Available, In Use, or Lost
features.import_export: Import and Export visitor card inventory via Excel/CSV

manage_records.title: Add, edit & delete visitor cards

steps.1: Click the add card button to register a new physical RFID/Barcode card number and code.
steps.2: Select the card category and initial availability status (Available or Lost).
steps.3: Use the Edit action on a card row to update its badge code or mark a missing card as Lost.
steps.4: Delete card records that were entered by mistake and have never been issued.

manage_records.tip: Cards marked In Use are tied to an active visit and automatically return to Available when the visitor checks out.

import_export.title: Import & Export card inventory

steps.1: Click the Import button and download the visitor card Excel/CSV template.
steps.2: Enter the list of card numbers and RFID/Barcode codes in the template file.
steps.3: Upload the file, inspect the card preview table, and run the Import.
steps.4: Click the Export button to download a full inventory and status report of all cards.

import_export.tip: Export the inventory periodically to audit physical cards available at the gatehouse.

card_vehicles.title: Vehicle Cards
card_vehicles.purpose: Manage gate pass cards for 2-wheeled and 4-wheeled visitor vehicles.

features.gate_pass: Maintain vehicle pass card inventory by category and serial number
features.plate_pairing: Paired directly with vehicle license plate records during check-in and check-out
features.import_export: Import and Export vehicle card records using Excel/CSV templates

manage_records.title: Add, edit & delete vehicle pass cards

steps.1: Click the add button to register a new vehicle pass card serial number.
steps.2: Choose the vehicle category (2-wheeled, 4-wheeled, or operational) and availability status.
steps.3: Use the Edit action to update card details or mark damaged/missing cards.
steps.4: Use the Delete action to remove retired card numbers.

manage_records.tip: Vehicle cards are paired with the visitor's license plate at check-in and automatically released upon check-out.

import_export.title: Import & Export vehicle card records

steps.1: Open the Import dialog and download the vehicle card Excel/CSV template.
steps.2: Fill in the serial numbers and vehicle categories in the template columns.
steps.3: Upload the template file, verify the validation preview, and confirm saving.
steps.4: Click the Export button to download the vehicle card inventory in Excel/CSV format.

import_export.tip: Use distinct serial prefixes for 2-wheeled and 4-wheeled passes so gate officers can tell them apart quickly.

visitors.title: Visitors
visitors.purpose: Maintain the master archive of all visitors, contractors, and guests ever registered.

features.master_archive: Manage full visitor profiles, ID types, companies, and nationalities
features.visit_timeline: Detailed profile modal featuring an individual visit history timeline
features.print_and_export: Print visitor profile sheets and Import & Export master records via Excel/CSV

manage_records.title: Manage profiles & inspect visit timeline

steps.1: Use the search bar to locate a visitor by name, ID number, or company.
steps.2: Click the add button or Edit action to complete profile details, ID type, company, and nationality.
steps.3: Click a visitor profile to open the detail modal showing their complete visit history timeline.
steps.4: Use the Delete action to remove duplicate profiles that have no recorded visits.

manage_records.tip: Profile updates saved here will auto-populate the next time the visitor checks in at the gate.

import_export.title: Print profile, Import & Export visitors

steps.1: Open the visitor detail modal and click the print button to print an individual profile sheet.
steps.2: Click the Import button and download the Excel/CSV template to pre-load contractor or group profiles.
steps.3: Upload the completed file, inspect the validation preview, and save to the master archive.
steps.4: Click the Export button to download the master visitor archive as an Excel/CSV file.

import_export.tip: Importing subcontractor profiles ahead of arrival speeds up registration queues at the gate.

blacklist.title: Blacklist
blacklist.purpose: Manage the security blocklist of visitors prohibited from entering the shipyard.

features.block_management: Record violation reasons for blacklisting and restore access (Unblacklist) when authorized
features.cloud_hub_sync: Outbox synchronization with Cloud Hub to propagate blacklist updates across gates
features.import_export: Import and Export security blacklist records via Excel/CSV files

add_block.title: Add a visitor to the blocklist

steps.1: Search for the visitor record or open the add security blocklist (Blacklist) form.
steps.2: Enter the detailed security violation reason as a reference for gate officers.
steps.3: Save the block entry, or use Excel/CSV Import to process blocklist records in bulk.

add_block.tip: Blacklisted visitors automatically trigger a security block alert when their ID is scanned on the Add Visit page.

remove_block.title: Remove a block (Unblacklist)

steps.1: Search for the visitor's name or ID number in the Blacklist table.
steps.2: Click the restore access (Unblacklist) action on the authorized visitor row.
steps.3: Confirm removing the block so the visitor can be registered again on future visits.

remove_block.tip: Every block addition and removal is automatically recorded in the Activity Logs.

cloud_sync.title: Synchronize with Cloud Hub

steps.1: Check the synchronization status indicator and Cloud Hub Outbox queue on the Blacklist page.
steps.2: Verify that local blocklist changes are queued for cross-gate distribution.
steps.3: Trigger a manual sync action if connectivity to the Cloud Hub has just been restored.

cloud_sync.tip: The Outbox queue keeps blocklist updates safe while the gate operates offline.

visitor_report.title: Visitor Report
visitor_report.purpose: Generate analytical reports and summaries of visitor history across multiple criteria.

features.multi_filter: Multi-criteria filtering by date/time range, location, visitor type, company, and status
features.kpi_summary: Key performance indicator (KPI) summary for the selected reporting period
features.export_excel_pdf: Export reports to Excel (.xlsx) and official A4 Landscape PDF with company letterhead

filter_kpi.title: Apply filters, read KPIs & export report

steps.1: Select the arrival date/time range and additional criteria such as destination location, visitor type, company, or status.
steps.2: Review the key performance indicator (KPI) summary cards at the top for total visits in the selected period.
steps.3: Inspect the detailed visit rows in the report table to verify data completeness.
steps.4: Click Export Excel (.xlsx) for further analysis or Export PDF for an official A4 Landscape letterhead document.

filter_kpi.tip: Narrow the date range or location filter before generating a PDF if the dataset is very large.

vessel_report.title: Vessel Report
vessel_report.purpose: Generate summaries of vessel arrival and departure history at the shipyard.

features.arrival_recap: 2 view tabs: Details With Crew (default) and Vessel Summary, with status filters (In Port, Departed, Stay)
features.crew_stats: Summary statistics of active on-board crew and total crew movements per arrival
features.export_excel_pdf: Export vessel summaries to Excel (.xlsx) and official PDF reports

filter_kpi.title: Apply filters, review stats & export vessel report

steps.1: Select the Details With Crew tab (default) or Vessel Summary tab based on your reporting need.
steps.2: Filter by arrival date range, vessel name, agent, or vessel status (In Port, Departed, Stay).
steps.3: Review the active on-board crew count and total crew movement statistics for each arrival record.
steps.4: Click Export Excel (.xlsx) or Export PDF to download the official report document.

filter_kpi.tip: Use the Stay status filter to separate permanently staying fleet vessels (Tugboats & Barges) from Repair Vessels.

crew_report.title: Crew Report
crew_report.purpose: Generate comprehensive reports on seafarer placements and gate check-in/out activity.

features.three_modes: 2 view modes: Complete Log & Crew Activity History (default) and Vessel Crew Placements
features.seafarer_docs: Search by seaman book credentials, rank, nationality, and vessel name
features.export_excel_pdf: Export crew activity logs to Excel (.xlsx) and session-paired Landscape PDF (In, Out, whole-integer Days, ONBOARD status)

filter_kpi.title: Filter crew activity & export Excel/PDF

steps.1: Choose the Complete Log & Crew Activity History tab (default) or the Vessel Crew Placements tab.
steps.2: Filter records by crew name, seaman book number, vessel name, nationality, or placement status.
steps.3: Inspect the filtered table rows along with the total record summary.
steps.4: Click Export Excel (.xlsx) or Export PDF to download a session-paired Landscape report (In, Out, Days, and ONBOARD status).

filter_kpi.tip: Complete Log mode displays every individual gate check-in and check-out session chronologically.

system_users.title: System Users
system_users.purpose: Manage accounts for gate security officers, supervisors, and system administrators.

features.account_management: Create user accounts, update profile details, and activate/deactivate login access
features.role_assignment: Assign roles to control menu visibility and operational permissions
features.password_reset: Administrator password reset for officers who need credential recovery

create_account.title: Create a new user account

steps.1: Click the add user button on the System Users page to open the new account form.
steps.2: Fill in the full name, login username, email address, initial password, and active account status.
steps.3: Save the form so the officer can sign in immediately with those credentials.

create_account.tip: Use concise usernames that are quick for gate officers to type during shift handovers.

assign_role.title: Assign a user role

steps.1: Locate the officer's account in the users table and click the Edit action.
steps.2: Select the appropriate Role such as Administrator, Supervisor, Security, or a custom role.
steps.3: Save your changes to update the officer's menu visibility and feature permissions.

assign_role.tip: Assign the role that best matches the officer's daily operational responsibilities.

reset_password.title: Reset a user password

steps.1: Find the officer account requiring credential recovery in the System Users table.
steps.2: Open the Administrator password reset or credential update action.
steps.3: Enter a strong new password and confirm saving.

reset_password.tip: Advise the officer to change their password afterward via the My Profile page.

activity_logs.title: Activity Logs
activity_logs.purpose: Inspect the security audit trail of all sensitive actions and data changes in the system.

features.audit_trail: Automatic logging of sensitive events (logins, check-ins/outs, master data edits, blacklist)
features.actor_ip_time: Detailed timestamp, actor identity, target subject, and client IP address
features.filter_search: Filter and search audit logs by date range, action category, and user

roles.title: Role Management
roles.purpose: Configure the permission matrix for each user role in the application.

features.permission_matrix: Granular permission toggles for viewing, creating, editing, or deleting per module
features.protected_builtin: Built-in protection for the 3 core roles (Administrator, Supervisor, Security)
features.custom_roles: Create and customize additional roles to fit operational needs

custom_roles.title: Create a custom role & configure permissions

steps.1: Click the add role button to create a custom role alongside the 3 built-in system roles.
steps.2: Enter the role name and a short description of its operational scope.
steps.3: Toggle granular permissions (view, create, edit, delete) for each module in the permission matrix.
steps.4: Save the role configuration so it can be assigned to accounts on the System Users page.

custom_roles.tip: The 3 built-in roles (Administrator, Supervisor, Security) are protected to keep core access safe.

my_profile.title: My Profile
my_profile.purpose: Manage your personal account identity and change your password.

features.personal_info: Update full name, quick-login uppercase username, and email address
features.change_password: Self-service password change form with security validation
features.role_badges: View your active account identity and assigned role badges

change_password.title: Change your account password

steps.1: Open the My Profile page and review your account identity and assigned Role badges.
steps.2: Update your full name, uppercase quick-login username, or email address if needed.
steps.3: In the password security section, enter your current password followed by the new password and confirmation.
steps.4: Click the save button to apply the new password to your account.

change_password.tip: Update your password periodically and never share gatehouse login credentials.

app_overview.title: App Overview
app_overview.purpose: Provide a quick reference to every screen's purpose and your account's access status.

features.module_catalog: Complete catalog of all VMS Core screens grouped to match the sidebar navigation
features.access_indicator: Live indicator of which screens your account can open, with direct shortcut links
features.quick_search: Instant client-side search by page name, purpose, or feature, plus quick-jump links

bilingual.title: Bilingual (ID & EN)
bilingual.description: Use the globe ID / EN switcher in the top-right header to switch the interface language at any time.

dark_mode.title: Dark & Light Mode
dark_mode.description: Click the sun/moon icon in the top header to toggle between light and dark themes. Your preference is saved automatically.

cloud_sync.title: Offline-First & Cloud Hub Sync
cloud_sync.description: The gate app operates reliably on the local LAN without internet and syncs blacklist updates via the Cloud Hub indicator.

master_import_export.title: Master Data Import & Export
master_import_export.description: All 6 Master Data screens include template downloads, import previews, and Excel/CSV export tools.

1.title: Sidebar Navigation Menu
1.description: Use the left sidebar menu to switch between operational modules available to your account role.

2.title: Quick Guide Search
2.description: Type a screen name, route, feature, or step keyword to filter guide cards immediately.

3.title: Module Jump Links
3.description: Click any module group shortcut to scroll directly to that section.

4.title: Screen Card & Step-by-Step Guide
4.description: Each card shows the screen purpose, key features, collapsible step-by-step guides, and a Try Now shortcut.

5.title: Language Switcher (ID / EN)
5.description: Switch between Indonesian and English at any time using the ID / EN buttons in the top bar.

6.title: Dark & Light Theme
6.description: Click the theme icon to adjust display contrast for day or night shift conditions.

7.title: Profile & User Options
7.description: Check your active account identity or sign out from the user panel at the bottom of the sidebar.

1.title: Add Visit Module
1.description: Start registering new guests or contractors at the gatehouse from the Add Visit screen.

2.title: Search Visitor by Name
2.description: Type the name of a registered visitor in the Name field and press Enter or pick from the autocomplete suggestions.

3.title: Or Detect by ID Number
3.description: Alternatively, select the ID Type (KTP, Driving License, or Passport), enter the ID Number, and click Check ID number.

4.title: Verification & Security Alert Panel
4.description: Check the right-hand panel: green means verified, red means blocked on the security blocklist, and amber means not yet registered in Visitor Directory.

5.title: Step 2: Select Destination Location / Vessel & Host
5.description: Choose the destination land zone or vessel, enter the purpose of visit, and select the internal Host staff member.

6.title: Step 3: Select Physical Access Card & Vehicle
6.description: Select at least one Available physical Visitor Card (mandatory), plus the license plate and vehicle pass card if bringing a vehicle.

7.title: Save & Print ½ A4 Visitor Pass
7.description: Click Save & Print Ticket on the bottom bar to save the check-in and immediately print the ½ A4 Visitor Pass ticket.

8.title: Visit History & Check-Out
8.description: When the guest leaves, search by name, card, or license plate in Visit History and click Check-Out to release the cards back to Available.

1.title: 1. Vessel Prerequisite: Locations & Vessels
1.description: If the vessel is not yet in the system, register it first on the Locations & Vessels screen (choose Repair Vessel, Tug Boat, or Barge with IMO & Captain).

2.title: 2. Crew Prerequisite: Visitor Directory
2.description: If seafarer profiles are not yet registered, add them in Visitor Directory with Visitor Type = Crew (or via Excel Import).

3.title: 3. Record New Arrival Button
3.description: Click Record New Arrival to open the berthed vessel arrival registration modal form.

4.title: 4. Select Berthed Vessel from Master Data
4.description: Select the arriving vessel from the master database. Selecting a vessel is required before managing the crew manifest in the next step.

5.title: 5. Open Crew Selection Dialog
5.description: Click the Manage Vessel Crew button. Once a vessel is selected, the seafarer selection dialog opens to assign crew to the initial manifest.

6.title: 6. Select Seafarers in Selection Dialog
6.description: Check the names of seafarers serving on-board to link them directly to this vessel arrival.

7.title: 7. Apply Crew to Arrival Form
7.description: Click Apply Crew so all checked seafarers are transferred into the vessel arrival manifest summary.

8.title: 8. Save & Register Vessel Arrival
8.description: Click Save Arrival to complete the vessel registration along with all seafarers on its initial manifest.

9.title: 9. Fast Check-In / Check-Out via Unified Search
9.description: Type a crew or vessel name in this Unified Search box to filter manifest statuses instantly from anywhere.

10.title: 10. Open Crew Manifest & Vessel Detail Modal
10.description: Click the Detail action button (eye icon / manage crew) on any berthed vessel row to open the crew manifest management modal.

11.title: 11. Crew Manifest & Vessel Management Modal
11.description: Inside this modal dialog, manage on-board Check-In / Check-Out statuses, detach crew, and download movement logs using the Export Log Excel button.

12.title: 12. Berth Status Filter & Vessel Check-Out (Departed)
12.description: When a Repair Vessel completes work and sails out, trigger Check-Out / Departed on the vessel row.

1.title: 1. Master Locations & Vessels (/master/locations)
1.description: Manage CRUD (Add, Edit, Delete) for yard land locations and vessels (Repair Vessel, Tug Boat, Barge), complete with Excel Import & Export.

2.title: 2. Master Host Staffs (/master/staffs)
2.description: Manage CRUD for internal host employees, customize visible table columns, restore deleted records from Trash, and run Excel Import & Export.

3.title: 3. Master Visitor Cards (/master/cards)
3.description: Manage CRUD for physical visitor card inventory, monitor automatic card status (Available, In Use, Lost, Damaged), and run Excel Import & Export.

4.title: 4. Master Vehicle Cards (/master/vehicle-cards)
4.description: Manage CRUD for vehicle pass cards assigned to guest and operational vehicles entering the shipyard, complete with Excel Import & Export.

5.title: 5. Master Visitor Directory (/master/visitors)
5.description: Manage CRUD for the master directory of guests, contractors, and vessel crew (KTP/SIM/Passport), view visit counts, Import/Export Excel, or block offenders.

6.title: 6. Security Blocklist & Cloud Hub (/master/visitors/blacklist)
6.description: Add new security blocks, remove blocks (Unblock), Import/Export Excel, and switch to the Global tab for multi-branch Cloud Hub synchronization.

1.title: Register Visit
1.description: Verify visitor ID, assign destination & Host, and allocate access cards.

2.title: Print Pass
2.description: Print the ½ A4 Visitor Pass ticket for the guest while inside the shipyard.

3.title: Track History
3.description: Monitor active visitors inside the yard (In Yard) or reprint entry passes.

4.title: Check-out
4.description: Process individual or group check-outs at the exit gate.

5.title: Cards Released
5.description: Visitor and vehicle cards automatically return to Available status.

1.title: Register Arrival
1.description: Record berthed vessel schedule, port of origin, agents, and initial manifest.

2.title: Crew Manifest
2.description: Manage seafarer Check-In, Check-Out, Detach, or Vessel Transfer actions.

3.title: Export Logs
3.description: Download the crew gate movement activity history as an Excel file.

4.title: Vessel Departed
4.description: Mark Repair Vessels as Departed when they leave the shipyard.

simulator.title: Interactive Simulation & Visual Page Examples
simulator.subtitle: Try out guest registration, physical card check-out, and vessel crew manifest actions visually without affecting live records.

visit_create.step1_instruction: Click one of the sample guest profiles below to see how the screen responds in real time:
visit_create.method_name_hint: Search by Name mode: Type a visitor name and pick from autocomplete suggestions (or click a sample below):
visit_create.method_id_hint: Search by ID mode: Select ID type (KTP/SIM/Passport) and check the ID number (click a sample below):
visit_create.status_blocked: Security Alert: Guest on Security Blocklist
visit_create.blocked_reason_text: Reason: PPE & restricted zone violation. Destination, card assignment, and pass printing are locked automatically.
visit_create.status_unregistered: Visitor is not registered in the directory
visit_create.unregistered_help_text: New guests must first be added in the Visitor Directory screen before proceeding with check-in.
visit_create.select_card_label: Select Visitor Card (Cards in use are locked automatically):
